source_text: What the hell are they doing?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.What the hell are they doing?

source_text: Stay low so they don’t see us.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Stay low so they don’t see us.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Stay low so they don’t see us."

translation: Trzymaj się nisko, żeby nas nie zauważyli.

source_text: I have no idea… But it’s a popular hangout spot for those creepy sick guys.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I have no idea… But it’s a popular hangout spot for those creepy sick guys.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I have no idea… But it’s a popular hangout spot for those creepy sick guys."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia… Ale ci przerażający chorzy często się tu kręcą.

source_text: I just want a closer look.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I just want a closer look.

translation: Chcę tylko podejść bliżej i się przyjrzeć.

source_text: This is some sort of torture chamber.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.This is some sort of torture chamber.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.This is some sort of torture chamber."

source_text: Who are they torturing?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Who are they torturing?

source_text: Us, if we don’t get out of here soon.

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.Us, if we don’t get out of here soon.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.Us, if we don’t get out of here soon."

translation: Nas, jeśli szybko się stąd nie wyniesiemy.

source_text: I don’t think that’s what it is.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I don’t think that’s what it is.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I don’t think that’s what it is."

translation: Nie sądzę, żeby o to chodziło.

source_text: What are those sounds?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.What are those sounds?

source_text: There is something on the other side of that strange metal thing.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.There is something on the other side of that strange metal thing.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.There is something on the other side of that strange metal thing."

translation: Coś jest po drugiej stronie tego dziwnego metalowego czegoś.

source_text: Another room?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.Another room?

source_text: Maybe. I can’t quite tell.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Maybe. I can’t quite tell.

source_text: We’re pushing our luck.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.We’re pushing our luck.

source_text: As long as those lepers are around there’s no way to get through.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.As long as those lepers are around there’s no way to get through.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.As long as those lepers are around there’s no way to get through."

translation: Dopóki kręcą się tu trędowaci, nie ma jak się przedostać.

source_text: So… What are you going to do?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.So… What are you going to do?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.So… What are you going to do?"

source_text: I’ll come back later…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I’ll come back later…

source_text: You don’t have to ask me twice.

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.You don’t have to ask me twice.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.You don’t have to ask me twice."

translation: Nie musisz mi dwa razy powtarzać.

source_text: Get away from him, you monster!

structure.raw_value: BrMaAgNo1.Get away from him, you monster!

source_text: I have a crucifix! You better get back!

structure.raw_value: BrMaAg.I have a crucifix! You better get back!
structure.script_literal: "BrMaAg.I have a crucifix! You better get back!"

source_text: You’re standing in my way! You will not take him from us!

structure.raw_value: LiMaEx^.You’re standing in my way! You will not take him from us!
structure.script_literal: "LiMaEx^.You’re standing in my way! You will not take him from us!"

translation: Stoisz mi na drodze! Nie odbierzesz nam go!

source_text: It’s okay, Brian. I made peace with them.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.It’s okay, Brian. I made peace with them.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.It’s okay, Brian. I made peace with them."

translation: W porządku, Brian. Pogodziłem się z nimi.

source_text: They’ve brainwashed you!

structure.raw_value: BrMaAg.They’ve brainwashed you!

source_text: You are the one brainwashing the people of Earth!

structure.raw_value: LiAnEx^.You are the one brainwashing the people of Earth!
structure.script_literal: "LiAnEx^.You are the one brainwashing the people of Earth!"

translation: To ty pierzesz mózgi mieszkańcom Ziemi!

source_text: I said, get back!

structure.raw_value: BrMaAgNo1.I said, get back!

source_text: These worlds are governed by chaos. And it’s people like you that have let it happen.

structure.raw_value: LiMaAgNo1^.These worlds are governed by chaos. And it’s people like you that have let it happen.
structure.script_literal: "LiMaAgNo1^.These worlds are governed by chaos. And it’s people like you that have let it happen."

translation: Tymi światami rządzi chaos. To tacy jak ty do tego dopuścili.

source_text: You worship a false god!

structure.raw_value: LiMaEx^.You worship a false god!

source_text: Can we just make peace here?

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.Can we just make peace here?

source_text: It’s time, 1Hero. You know what to do.

structure.raw_value: LiAnOp^.It’s time, 1Hero. You know what to do.
structure.script_literal: "LiAnOp^.It’s time, 1Hero. You know what to do."

source_text: Well, shit. There she goes again.

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.Well, shit. There she goes again.

source_text: Never better!... Where is Kimberly?

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.Never better!... Where is Kimberly?

translation: Nigdy nie czułem się lepiej!... Gdzie jest Kimberly?

source_text: Tasha ran with her to the church… I came back after I didn’t see you following us.

structure.raw_value: BrWoEx.Tasha ran with her to the church… I came back after I didn’t see you following us.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoEx.Tasha ran with her to the church… I came back after I didn’t see you following us."

translation: Tasha pobiegła z nią do kościoła… Wróciłem, bo nie widziałem, żebyś szedł za nami.

source_text: Brian, it’s okay. We beat Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.Brian, it’s okay. We beat Madalyn.

translation: Brian, wszystko w porządku. Pokonaliśmy Madalyn.

source_text: My name is Father Solomon.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.My name is Father Solomon.

source_text: Yeah, yeah. Sure.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Yeah, yeah. Sure.

source_text: What about Diana and Henry?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What about Diana and Henry?

translation: A co z Dianą i Henrym?

source_text: I don’t know where they went… They can fend for themselves.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.I don’t know where they went… They can fend for themselves.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.I don’t know where they went… They can fend for themselves."

translation: Nie wiem, dokąd poszli… Sami sobie poradzą.

source_text: Did we win?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Did we win?

source_text: We saved Kimberly from the monsters… That’s good enough for now.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.We saved Kimberly from the monsters… That’s good enough for now.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.We saved Kimberly from the monsters… That’s good enough for now."

translation: Uratowaliśmy Kimberly przed potworami… Na razie wystarczy.

source_text: What are you doing back here?

structure.raw_value: ElWoCl.What are you doing back here?

source_text: Erica is destroying the mansion!

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.Erica is destroying the mansion!

source_text: Daemalius is blocking us from leaving! I have to go through the rift!

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Daemalius is blocking us from leaving! I have to go through the rift!
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Daemalius is blocking us from leaving! I have to go through the rift!"

translation: Daemalius nie pozwala nam uciec! Muszę przejść przez rozdarcie!

source_text: It’s a battle! They are fighting each other!

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.It’s a battle! They are fighting each other!
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.It’s a battle! They are fighting each other!"

translation: Trwa walka! Biją się między sobą!

source_text: What the fuck do we do now?

structure.raw_value: BoWoOp>.What the fuck do we do now?
structure.script_literal: "BoWoOp>.What the fuck do we do now?"

source_text: We go to Hell and we bring the bomb with us.

structure.raw_value: TaAnEx.We go to Hell and we bring the bomb with us.
structure.script_literal: "TaAnEx.We go to Hell and we bring the bomb with us."

translation: Idziemy do piekła i zabieramy bombę ze sobą.

source_text: How are we going to save Erica now?

structure.raw_value: NeWoOp^.How are we going to save Erica now?
structure.script_literal: "NeWoOp^.How are we going to save Erica now?"

source_text: Lillian said her soul will appear on the altar in Hell.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Lillian said her soul will appear on the altar in Hell.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Lillian said her soul will appear on the altar in Hell."

translation: Lillian mówiła, że jej dusza pojawi się na ołtarzu w piekle.

source_text: If she commits blasphemy.

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx^.If she commits blasphemy.

source_text: She’ll do it! I believe in her.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx.She’ll do it! I believe in her.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrEx.She’ll do it! I believe in her."

source_text: That's… kinda strange…

structure.raw_value: BrWoDe^.That's… kinda strange…

source_text: Shit! We have to hurry!

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Shit! We have to hurry!

source_text: This place is going to collapse.

structure.raw_value: AdWoOp>.This place is going to collapse.

source_text: There’s no escape?

structure.raw_value: ObWoCl>.There’s no escape?

source_text: Everyone, stop your bickering and let’s get our asses to Hell!

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx^.Everyone, stop your bickering and let’s get our asses to Hell!
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx^.Everyone, stop your bickering and let’s get our asses to Hell!"

translation: Wszyscy przestańcie się kłócić i ruszajmy do piekła!

source_text: What a day.

structure.raw_value: DiAnDe.What a day.

source_text: I can’t follow… But I will do what I can from here.

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.I can’t follow… But I will do what I can from here.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.I can’t follow… But I will do what I can from here."

translation: Nie mogę za wami iść… Ale pomogę, jak tylko będę mógł.

source_text: 1Hero… I think it’s open.

structure.raw_value: AdShEx.1Hero… I think it’s open.

source_text: Nevermind that. We need Father Solomon.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Nevermind that. We need Father Solomon.

source_text: Just go inside and take a peek.

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx>.Just go inside and take a peek.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx>.Just go inside and take a peek."

translation: Po prostu wejdź i rzuć okiem.

source_text: You take a look!

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You take a look!

source_text: Both of you, shut up…

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.Both of you, shut up…

source_text: 1Hero… Take a look.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.1Hero… Take a look.

source_text: Not without Father Solomon.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Not without Father Solomon.

source_text: Go in there, Vayne. You’re a woman. She’ll go easy on you.

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx>.Go in there, Vayne. You’re a woman. She’ll go easy on you.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx>.Go in there, Vayne. You’re a woman. She’ll go easy on you."

translation: Wejdź tam, Vayne. Jesteś kobietą, będzie dla ciebie łagodniejsza.

source_text: Shit. We’re wasting time.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Shit. We’re wasting time.

source_text: What are you girls doing down here?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What are you girls doing down here?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What are you girls doing down here?"

source_text: How the hell do we open the rift?

structure.raw_value: ElWoOp^.How the hell do we open the rift?
structure.script_literal: "ElWoOp^.How the hell do we open the rift?"

source_text: We need to get that Toma.

structure.raw_value: NeWoEx.We need to get that Toma.

source_text: If we can stop Lilith and close the rift, they can keep the damn Toma.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.If we can stop Lilith and close the rift, they can keep the damn Toma.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.If we can stop Lilith and close the rift, they can keep the damn Toma."

translation: Jeśli powstrzymamy Lilith i zamkniemy rozdarcie, mogą sobie zatrzymać tę cholerną Tomę.

source_text: How can you say that? They could find a way to use it.

structure.raw_value: ElWoEx^.How can you say that? They could find a way to use it.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoEx^.How can you say that? They could find a way to use it."

translation: Jak możesz tak mówić? Mogą znaleźć sposób, żeby jej użyć.

source_text: They could reopen the rift.

structure.raw_value: NeWoEx.They could reopen the rift.

source_text: You really think you can enter Hell and find a magic rock that, if you look at it, you’ll die?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You really think you can enter Hell and find a magic rock that, if you look at it, you’ll die?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You really think you can enter Hell and find a magic rock that, if you look at it, you’ll die?"

translation: Naprawdę myślisz, że wejdziesz do piekła i znajdziesz magiczny kamień, na który wystarczy spojrzeć, by umrzeć?

source_text: If anyone can do it, I can.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx^.If anyone can do it, I can.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrEx^.If anyone can do it, I can."

translation: Jeśli ktoś da radę, to ja.

source_text: I’ve been through worse.

structure.raw_value: NeFlDe.I’ve been through worse.

source_text: Worse? How is that possible?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Worse? How is that possible?

source_text: I’ve lived a long life.

structure.raw_value: NeFlEx.I’ve lived a long life.

source_text: Help us find the amulets.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Help us find the amulets.

source_text: Fine. But we’ll have to deal with this rift eventually.

structure.raw_value: ElAnEx^.Fine. But we’ll have to deal with this rift eventually.
structure.script_literal: "ElAnEx^.Fine. But we’ll have to deal with this rift eventually."

translation: Dobra. Ale w końcu będziemy musieli zająć się tym rozdarciem.

source_text: Be careful, Ella. Finding the Toma isn’t worth losing your life.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Be careful, Ella. Finding the Toma isn’t worth losing your life.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Be careful, Ella. Finding the Toma isn’t worth losing your life."

translation: Uważaj, Ello. Żaden Toma nie jest wart utraty życia.
